status: authored 2026-09-29; file-valid only. Nothing here has been seen in a running game.
supersedes_why: the COBBLEVERSE donor shell (27x24, one oval room, no second storey) is taken down by tools/gym_demolish.py and this hall is built on its lot. docs/world-building/GYM_BUILDINGS_BRIEF.md: the owner rejected a shaft into a cave under the shell and asked for a large building with the puzzle inside it.
name: The Stoneworks Hall
reading: Brock's town is the plateau's builders (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md: masons who build in the plateau's stone; palette stone, polished andesite, cobblestone, tuff, calcite, stripped birch and spruce). The gym is their works hall: the biggest roof in town, standing alone on the south-east knoll, with a wall being raised inside it. The climb is the building's own construction - the stone stair to the masons' loft, the gantry over the cutting floor, the unfinished wall's stepped end, the jib beams over the void and the hoist shaft behind the cross wall. Brock works on the gallery at the top of the hoist, and there is no other way to him.

site.lot_source: data/placements.json settlements.gym1_town.plan.anchors gym1_gym (rect, level 141, facing north). The prep cuts and fills the lot to that level (tools/place_town.py: 'a levelled lot is cut and filled to its level by the prep, so that is its ground'), and the plan's own status line records it built: 'gym lot flattened to y141'.

ground.why: the pad is the ground here. The raw heightmap over the lot is y140-142 (tools/ground.py, rounded, measured over all 1,920 columns: 140 at 15, 141 at 237, 142 at 1,668); the prep cuts it flat to 141. Neither number was read from a world.

site.footprint_size_why: 33 by 36. The brief's envelope for this site is 89x89, which is what the terrain and the neighbouring anchors allow and not a target - a building that size would dwarf the town. The lot the town plan reserved is 40x48, and this fills it with a 4/3/8/4 margin (west/east/north/south) for the forecourt and the eaves. The donor shell it replaces was 27x24.
site.facing_why: the lot anchor is `facing: north` and the lane climbs to the knoll from the plaza, north-west of it.

bounds_why: the hall (1810..1842 x 3664..3699), its one-block eaves and the timber buttress posts outside the walls (x1809 and x1843, z3663 and z3700), and the paved forecourt in front of the door (z3659..3663). Inside the lot rect on every side.

leader.name: Brock
leader.why: EXP-013 E2 (VERIFIED, on staging): a bare rctmod:trainer_spawner set by command with TrainerIds ['kanto_brock'] on a redstone block spawned Brock and he battled. The donor template does the same thing - its redstone_block at [6,0,12] sits under its spawner at [6,1,12]. Taking the shell down removes the template's spawner, so this one is the only kanto_brock in the town and the badge cannot be won without reaching the gallery (a persistent kanto_brock anywhere awards the badge: verified on staging 2026-09-24, docs/STATE.md).

rooms.why: the way in, under the north gable. From here the whole hall is legible: the loft on the left, the stacks, the two gantries, the unfinished wall ahead and the cross wall behind it with three slots high in it, one of them lit.
the working floor: stonecutters, a grindstone, cut stone stacked, and the straw the masons pack under a fall.
the masons' loft along the west wall, five above the floor. Stage 1 ends here.
two plank walks east off the loft at the same level. The north one stops in mid air over the cutting floor; the south one reaches the scaffold deck at the wall.
the wall being raised: a mass of stone brick eleven courses high whose east end is still stepped, which is the only climb from the scaffold deck to the crest.
six blocks of open air between the wall's crest and the cross wall, floored with straw. Nothing crosses it but the three jib beams.
the cross wall, two courses thick and eighteen high, pierced by three slots at the beams' level. Two are one course deep and blind; the third goes through into the hoist shaft and is the only way on.
the hoist: a four by four shaft cut through the gallery's masonry, with the loading ledge at the slot's level, the ladder on its east wall and straw at the bottom where the chute lands.

Brock's gallery, fifteen above the floor and sealed on all four sides: the cross wall to the north, the hall walls elsewhere, the roof above. The ladder out of the hoist and a chute back down are the only openings in its floor.

route.why: four squared blocks stacked into a stair at x1816-1817, z3679 up to z3676, tops 142/143/144/145, then one step west onto the loft (top 146).
route.not_skippable: the loft's deck stands at y146, five above the floor. Every other stack on the cutting floor tops at y143 or y144, which leaves a two-block rise to the deck, and no player can mount two blocks without a slab, a jump effect or a block to place. The three decoys are visible from the door, so the choice is made by looking, not by trying.

route.why: two plank walks leave the loft's east edge at y146. The north one (z3672-3673) ends at x1828 over the cutting floor; the south one (z3680-3681) runs eighteen blocks to the scaffold deck at the wall.
route.not_skippable: the scaffold deck is also five above the floor and is reached from nowhere else: the dead end's tip is five blocks and six in z from anything, and both are two above the tallest stack under them. Walking off either drops five blocks onto straw.

route.why: the wall's east end is still stepped - x1833 tops at 147, then 148, 149, 150, 151, 152 - so it is climbed one course at a time from the deck onto the crest.
route.not_skippable: the wall is sheer on its other three faces, eleven above the floor. The steps are the only one-block rise anywhere on it.

route.why: three squared timbers, one block wide and six long, cross the void from the crest to the cross wall at x1815, x1821 and x1827.
route.not_skippable: the void is six blocks of open air. A vanilla sprint jump clears four; there is no run-up on a one-wide crest and nothing to land on between. Missing a beam is an eleven-block fall onto straw, which does no damage, and the climb starts again at the stair.

route.why: the three slots in the cross wall are at the beams' level. x1815 and x1821 are one course deep and blind; x1827 goes through both courses into the hoist. Two lanterns hang inside the shaft under the gallery floor and the light spills out of the true slot only - the same clue Misty's three mouths use.
route.not_skippable: the cross wall is solid from the floor to y159 apart from the three slots and the archway at its foot, and the gallery above it stands three courses over the beams.

route.why: the loading ledge fills the shaft's north half at the slot's level; the ladder is on the shaft's east wall over the open half and climbs four to the gallery floor.
route.not_skippable: the ladder's foot is at y153, eleven above the straw at the shaft's bottom, so nobody who falls down the shaft can climb back up it. The gallery is sealed on all four sides and its floor has exactly two holes: this ladder and the chute.

route.why: the spawner stands on a redstone block in the gallery floor with two air cells over it; Brock spawns on it. His chest is four east.
route.not_skippable: this is the only rctmod:trainer_spawner in the town once the donor shell is down.

route.why: a one-block hole in the gallery floor at (1827,155,3698) drops fourteen into the shaft's straw, and an archway at the shaft's foot leads back into the hall. The player steps into it from the gallery floor beside it, which is why this step starts at (1826,156,3698) and not in the hole itself: the hole is not a cell anyone stands in (GYM_BUILDINGS_REVIEW.md D5's class of defect, found here 2026-09-29). The ladder still goes both ways, so the chute is a shortcut and never a trap.
route.not_skippable: not a route step: the way back.

route.why: the north gantry's dead end is two blocks in z and one down from the head of the stage 1 stair, so a player who walks the wrong gantry hops back onto the stair instead of dropping five onto the straw. Declared because it is real: the independent audit's jump model crosses it (GYM_BUILDINGS_REVIEW.md D3), and an undeclared crossing between two rooms is indistinguishable from a gate that leaks.
route.not_skippable: not a route step: the way back off the decoy. It descends onto a cell the player has already stood on to begin stage 1, so it passes no gate and shortens nothing.

trainers_why: none authored here, and deliberately. A gym trainer has to be unavoidable, and unavoidability on this route is a claim about where a player can physically stand and how far a trainer can see - the independent movement model (tools/gym_interiors_independent.py) is what settles that, and it is not this unit's to write (CLAUDE.md principle 16). The record's `trainers` array is supported by the generator and is the place seats go once somebody who is not the builder has checked them.

no_build.why: the whole hall. Authored, not wired: the scene runtime's adventure-mode box (tools/scenes_pack.py no_build) needs a scene record in data/scenes.json and that is not written in this unit. Until it is, a player with blocks can build past the void.

spawn_suppression.note: data/gym_interiors.json gyms[gym1].spawn_suppression, unchanged. The hall sits inside it (x1809..1843 is inside 1808..1847; z3659..3700 is NOT: the forecourt paving and the north eaves at z3659..3663 fall north of the box's edge). Nothing in this hall is a spawn-condition block, so the exposure is the apron's polished andesite in the open, which the town's own streets already are. Extending the box is a one-line edit in data/spawn_suppression.json and belongs to whoever owns that file.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym1_town) and nothing that is a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json: no grass, no leaves, no water, no carpet.
